name: siv3d
description: Siv3D engine dependencies (static, vcpkg manifest mode).

overrides.$comment: Vendored boost.geometry 'dissolve' extension needs overlay internals removed in 1.89+; keep geometry at 1.88 while the rest of boost follows the baseline.
overrides.name: boost-geometry

overrides.$comment: abseil is in Siv3D's PUBLIC ABI (Int128.hpp etc.); pin the LTS that matches the formerly-vendored copy so the inline namespace (lts_20250814) and ABI stay identical. Consumers must resolve the same version.
overrides.name: abseil

overrides.$comment: fmt is in Siv3D's PUBLIC ABI (FormatLiteralObject.hpp); pin the formerly-vendored 12.1.0 so the versioned inline namespace (fmt::v12) and ABI stay identical.
overrides.name: fmt

overrides.$comment: toml11 is in Siv3D's PUBLIC ABI (TOML.hpp); pin the formerly-vendored 4.4.0 so the parsed-value types stay ABI-identical for consumers.
overrides.name: toml11
